releaseNotes:
🎬 Direct Instagram Reel & 📷 WhatsApp Photos Retention (v1.2.7):
• 🎬 Direct Instagram Reels: Direct shortcode and deep link extraction ensures clicking 'Watch Reel' opens the exact reel instead of the generic home feed, with clean fallback directly to Instagram Direct messages.
• 📷 Reliable WhatsApp Photo Saving: Fixed deduplication to preserve every photo in chat history, expanded media scan search window to 5 minutes, added modern Android storage directories, and progressive 3-stage scanning for background downloads.
• ☁️ Google Drive & Cloud Backup: Verified 100% offline cloud export with official Google vector badges.
